text: You see a chanter from the Children
source_text: You see a chanter from the Children

text: The Master will forgive your sins! Join us and be free! Praise to the Master and his mercy!
source_text:
The Master will forgive your sins! Join us and be free! Praise
 to the Master and his mercy!

text: Hello friend! Will you sing a song of Praise with me? . . . Once I was wandering blind, In a land that was so unkind . . .
source_text:
Hello friend! Will you sing a song of Praise with me? . . . Once I
 was wandering blind, In a land that was so unkind . . .

text: I hate to interrupt your hymn, but where might I meet the Master?
source_text: I hate to interrupt your hymn, but where might I meet the Master?

text: . . . but now I kiss the Master's behind . . .
source_text: . . . but now I kiss the Master's behind . . .

text: Happy! Happy! I sing song good!
source_text: Happy! Happy! I sing song good!

text: He finds you when and where you least expect it! Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame! Praise the world!
source_text:
He finds you when and where you least expect it! Praise the Master!
 Praise the Holy Flame! Praise the world!

text: What a wonderful joke! I used to have no sense of humor, but thanks to the Master, I am full of mirth! Praise the Master!
source_text:
What a wonderful joke! I used to have no sense of humor,
 but thanks to the Master, I am full of mirth! Praise the Master!

text: The one who sits above. The one who sits below. The one who rests within. Praise the Master for such clarity of vision!
source_text:
The one who sits above. The one who sits below. The one who rests
 within. Praise the Master for such clarity of vision!

text: Oh, if only I were so fortunate! Perhaps one day the Master will let me kiss his body parts. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
source_text:
Oh, if only I were so fortunate! Perhaps one day the Master will
 let me kiss his body parts. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!

text: Hmm, that's not what I had in mind. You had better practice, my friend. Praise to the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
source_text:
Hmm, that's not what I had in mind. You had better practice, my
 friend. Praise to the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
